newsitem.title: USA: Maraven, Conoco award $500 mln Venezuela contract.
newsitem.headline: Maraven, Conoco award $500 mln Venezuela contract.

text.p: Petrozuata CA, a joint venture between Maraven and DuPont Co's Conoco subsidiary has awarded a $500 million engineering contract to the CONTRINA consortium, Halliburton Co said in a statement.

The contract covers the process and utilities engineering, procurement and construction of a downstream project to process the extra heavy crude oil from the Zuata area of the Orinoco Belt in Venezuela.
CONTRINA is made up of Halliburton's Brown & Root subsidiary, the Parsons Process Group, France's Technip SA, and Venezuela's Proyecta and DIT-Harris.
The plant is designed to process 120,000 of extra heavy crude oil per day and will come onstream in mid-2000.
Petrozuata recently completed the $1.45 billion financing for the project, which includes a $1.0 billion bond issue. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
